skills.name: gitlab-backend
skills.description: Resolve which GitLab backend to use (GitLab MCP server or the glab CLI) and map every GitLab operation to the resolved backend. Prefers MCP, falls back to glab, and stops with setup guidance when neither is available.

skills.name: mr-review-address
skills.description: Retrieve, track, and systematically address GitLab merge request review comments. Persists state under .ai/gitlab/review/{branch}-{mr_iid}/ using the review-tracker TypeScript CLI only — never edit tracking JSON by hand. Use when the user wants to address MR feedback, respond to review comments, or resolve reviewer suggestions.

skills.name: check-branch-protection
skills.description: Determine whether the current user can push directly to a given branch (typically main) of a GitLab project, or whether changes must go through a merge request. Read-only; uses the dual backend (GitLab MCP server preferred, glab CLI fallback) and returns { protected, canPush, recommendation }. Use before pushing or publishing to decide push-vs-MR.
